faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common inquiries

items.answer1: We start with an initial consultation, followed by detailed planning, iterative development with constant feedback, and final delivery with support.
items.question2: How long does a project take?
items.answer2: It depends on the complexity. A simple website may take 2-4 weeks, while more complex applications can require 2-6 months.
items.question3: Do you work with remote teams?
items.answer3: Absolutely! I have experience working with distributed teams using tools like Slack, Zoom, GitHub, and agile methodologies.
